runs.last_step: Fetch the same pinned Boost headers as Windows
runs.finding: Boost archive checksum passed; unzip failed because build/boost parent directory did not exist.
runs.remediation: Create build/boost before unzip; applied on ci/linux-bootstrap.

runs.finding: CMake configure and initial GCC compilation succeeded; compilation stopped at ATen/functorch/Interpreter.h include nlohmann/json.hpp, which the Torch wheel does not supply. The prior local Windows environment supplied nlohmann/json 3.11.2 through ambient Conda include headers.
runs.remediation: Pin and verify nlohmann/json 3.11.2 as an explicit shared build dependency, include its MIT notice, rebuild and repeat CI.

interpretation: The workflow uses continue-on-error to keep Linux exploration independent of the Windows release. Its overall green result is not evidence of a successful Linux job. No Linux wheel has passed compilation, full tests, auditwheel, or clean installation.
next_step: Run both platform jobs at the revision containing the shared pinned JSON dependency; Windows-only release may proceed once its own mandatory gates pass.
